<script>
"use strict";
(function(){
const $=(s,r)=> (r||document).querySelector(s);
const $$=(s,r)=> Array.from((r||document).querySelectorAll(s));
const readJSON=id=>JSON.parse(document.getElementById(id).textContent);
const FOREST=readJSON("data-forest"), MARG=readJSON("data-margins"), CLO=readJSON("data-closure"),
      STEP=readJSON("data-stepper"), NAMES=readJSON("data-names"), CASES=readJSON("data-cases");
const EV={screen:readJSON("data-events-screen"),heldout:readJSON("data-events-heldout"),mesh:readJSON("data-events-mesh")};
const FOLDNAME={screen:"Screen",heldout:"Held-out",mesh:"MeSH"};
const SVGNS="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
const reduce=window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
const MINUS="−";

// ---------- formatting
const f2=v=>(v<0?MINUS:"")+Math.abs(v).toFixed(2);
const f3=v=>(v<0?MINUS:"")+Math.abs(v).toFixed(3);
const fp=p=>p<0.001?"<0.001":(p<0.1?p.toFixed(3):p.toFixed(2));
const fint=n=>n.toLocaleString("en-US");
const pct=v=>(100*v).toFixed(0)+"%";
const esc=s=>String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]));
const title=s=>s.replace(/\b([a-z])/g,(m,c)=>c.toUpperCase());

// ---------- events
function rowsOf(fold){const E=EV[fold];const c=E.cols;return E.rows.map((r,i)=>{const o={i,fold};c.forEach((k,j)=>o[k]=r[j]);return o;});}
const ROWS={screen:rowsOf("screen"),heldout:rowsOf("heldout"),mesh:rowsOf("mesh")};
const cname=id=>{const c=NAMES.concepts[id];return c?c.n:id;};
const sname=id=>NAMES.subfields[String(id)]||("subfield "+id);
function quantile(arr,q){const a=arr.slice().sort((x,y)=>x-y);const pos=(a.length-1)*q;const lo=Math.floor(pos),hi=Math.ceil(pos);return a[lo]+(a[hi]-a[lo])*(pos-lo);}
function pctRank(arr,v){let n=0;for(const x of arr) if(x<v) n++;return n/arr.length;}
const ASORT={}; for(const f in ROWS){ASORT[f]=ROWS[f].map(r=>r.A);}

// ---------- svg helpers
function S(tag,attrs,parent){const e=document.createElementNS(SVGNS,tag);for(const k in (attrs||{})) e.setAttribute(k,attrs[k]);if(parent) parent.appendChild(e);return e;}
function textW(svg,str,size,weight){const t=S("text",{x:-9999,y:-9999,"font-size":size||12,"font-weight":weight||400},svg);t.textContent=str;const w=t.getComputedTextLength();t.remove();return w;}
function newSvg(host,w,h,label){host.innerHTML="";const s=S("svg",{viewBox:`0 0 ${w} ${h}`,width:w,height:h,role:"img","aria-label":label});host.appendChild(s);return s;}
function widthOf(host){return Math.max(280,Math.floor(host.getBoundingClientRect().width));}

// ---------- chart tooltip
const tip=$("#tip");let tipOwner=null;
function showTip(target,html){tip.innerHTML=html;tip.classList.add("on");tipOwner=target;
  const r=target.getBoundingClientRect();const tw=tip.offsetWidth,th=tip.offsetHeight;
  let x=r.left+r.width/2-tw/2+window.scrollX;x=Math.max(8+window.scrollX,Math.min(x,window.scrollX+document.documentElement.clientWidth-tw-8));
  let y=r.top+window.scrollY-th-10;if(r.top-th-10<60) y=r.bottom+window.scrollY+10;
  tip.style.left=x+"px";tip.style.top=y+"px";}
function hideTip(){tip.classList.remove("on");tipOwner=null;}
function bindMark(g,html,label){g.setAttribute("tabindex","0");g.setAttribute("class",(g.getAttribute("class")||"")+" mark");g.setAttribute("role","button");g.setAttribute("aria-label",label);
  const on=()=>showTip(g,typeof html==="function"?html():html);
  g.addEventListener("mouseenter",on);g.addEventListener("focus",on);g.addEventListener("click",on);
  g.addEventListener("mouseleave",()=>{if(document.activeElement!==g) hideTip();});g.addEventListener("blur",hideTip);}
document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Escape"){hideTip();closeTerms();}});
document.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{if(tipOwner&&!tipOwner.contains(e.target)) hideTip();});
window.addEventListener("scroll",()=>{if(tipOwner&&tipOwner.getBoundingClientRect) {/* keep */}},{passive:true});

// ---------- glossary + term tooltips
const TERMS={
 entry:["Host-entry event","The first year in which a concept appears in a non-origin subfield together with at least five co-occurring partner terms."],
 share:["Host-vocabulary share","Denoted A_cont. The tag-weighted mean of each partner's pre-entry publication share in the host subfield, where each co-occurrence edge is weighted by its association strength."],
 ct:["Co-transfer","Denoted CT. The fraction of entry partners that were origin companions of the concept in the five years before entry."],
 newcomer:["Newcomer uptake","The count of host-subfield papers by author-disjoint newcomers (authors with no prior concept paper and no co-authorship with concept authors) during the five years after entry."],
 irr:["IRR per SD","Incidence-rate ratio per one standard deviation of the regressor: the factor by which expected newcomer papers change when the regressor rises by one SD. 1 means no effect."],
 ppml:["PPML","Poisson pseudo-maximum-likelihood regression, here with concept-clustered standard errors."],
 coprimary:["Co-primary specification","Concept, entry-year and host fixed effects. Declared for use when the primary drops below 30 concept clusters, which it does on the Held-out fold."],
 primary:["Primary specification","Concept-by-entry-year and host-by-entry-year fixed effects. It absorbs more confounding but keeps fewer events."],
 ivw:["IVW","Inverse-variance weighting: pooling fold estimates with weights proportional to their precision."],
 screen:["Screen fold","The development fold of the main arXiv concept pool (247 concepts; 202 after grounding filters)."],
 heldout:["Held-out fold","The second main-arm fold (119 concepts; 100 after grounding filters). It was used in pipeline development, so its estimates are development-set estimates."],
 mesh:["MeSH population","An independent biomedical arm of 191 concepts drawn from new MeSH descriptors, analysed with the same pre-registered test."],
 rooted:["Rooted (binary establishment)","An entry with at least five newcomer papers in at least three of the five outcome years."],
 extensive:["Extensive margin","Whether any newcomer uptake occurs. The intensive margin is the count of newcomer papers given that uptake started."],
 smd:["Standardised difference (S)","The standardised mean difference between concepts showing sustained uptake and matched controls over lags −3 to 0."],
 sustained:["Sustained uptake","A concept-year reaching at least 20 papers per year and gaining at least 20 percentile points in co-word network strength relative to the focal population."],
 holm:["Holm correction","A step-down adjustment of p-values for testing several hypotheses at once."],
 persist:["Persistent-neighbour closure","The closure coefficient restricted to top-20 neighbours present in both year y and y−1."],
 burt:["Burt constraint","A measure of how redundant a node's ego-network contacts are. Brokerage means low constraint."],
 fe:["Fixed effects","Indicators that absorb everything constant within a concept, an entry year or a host subfield (or their products), so the estimate compares entries within those cells."]
};
const ttHost=$("#tts");const ttEls={};let openTT=null,openTrig=null;
for(const k in TERMS){const d=document.createElement("div");d.className="tt";d.id="tt-"+k;d.setAttribute("role","tooltip");d.innerHTML=`<b>${esc(TERMS[k][0])}</b>${esc(TERMS[k][1])}`;ttHost.appendChild(d);ttEls[k]=d;}
function closeTerms(){if(openTT){openTT.classList.remove("on");openTT=null;openTrig=null;}}
function openTerm(btn){const k=btn.dataset.term;const d=ttEls[k];if(!d) return;if(openTT&&openTT!==d) openTT.classList.remove("on");
  d.classList.add("on");openTT=d;openTrig=btn;const r=btn.getBoundingClientRect();const w=d.offsetWidth;
  let x=r.left+window.scrollX;x=Math.max(8+window.scrollX,Math.min(x,window.scrollX+document.documentElement.clientWidth-w-8));
  d.style.left=x+"px";d.style.top=(r.bottom+window.scrollY+6)+"px";}
function wireTerms(root){$$(".term",root).forEach(b=>{if(b.dataset.wired) return;b.dataset.wired="1";b.type="button";b.setAttribute("aria-describedby","tt-"+b.dataset.term);
  ["mouseenter","focus","click"].forEach(ev=>b.addEventListener(ev,()=>openTerm(b)));
  b.addEventListener("mouseleave",()=>{if(document.activeElement!==b&&openTrig===b) closeTerms();});});}
document.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{if(openTT&&openTrig&&!openTrig.contains(e.target)&&!openTT.contains(e.target)) closeTerms();});
document.addEventListener("focusin",e=>{if(openTrig&&e.target!==openTrig) closeTerms();});
const gl=$("#gloss");Object.keys(TERMS).forEach(k=>{const dt=document.createElement("dt");dt.textContent=TERMS[k][0];const dd=document.createElement("dd");dd.textContent=TERMS[k][1];gl.append(dt,dd);});

// ---------- provenance list (from data-source attributes)
const PROV_VIEW={"data-forest":"Headline chart (folds, origin fields, placebo hosts)","data-events-screen":"Concept view, entry browser, try-it and failure views (Screen)","data-events-heldout":"Entry browser, try-it and failure views (Held-out)","data-events-mesh":"Entry browser, try-it and failure views (MeSH)","data-names":"Concept and subfield names, diffusion type","data-cases":"The paper's four representative cases","data-stepper":"The stepper's worked example","data-margins":"Margin ladder","data-closure":"Closure chart (RQ1)"};
$$('script[type="application/json"]').forEach(s=>{const li=document.createElement("li");li.innerHTML=`<strong>${esc(PROV_VIEW[s.id]||s.id)}</strong>: <code>${esc(s.dataset.source)}</code>`;$("#prov").appendChild(li);});

// ---------- resize handling
const renderers=[];function onResize(fn,host){renderers.push({fn,host,w:0});}
let rT=null;const ro=new ResizeObserver(()=>{clearTimeout(rT);rT=setTimeout(()=>{renderers.forEach(r=>{const w=Math.floor(r.host.getBoundingClientRect().width);if(w&&w!==r.w){r.w=w;r.fn();}});},80);});

// =====================================================================
// 1. HEADLINE FOREST
const FR=FOREST.rows;const get=(fold,spec,v)=>FR.find(r=>r.fold===fold&&r.spec===spec&&r.var===v);
const meshCo=get("mesh","co","A");
$("#bignum").textContent="+"+Math.round((meshCo.est-1)*100)+"%";
$("#bignum-cap").innerHTML=`newcomer uptake per SD of host-vocabulary share on MeSH: IRR ${f2(meshCo.est)}, 95% CI ${f2(meshCo.lo)} to ${f2(meshCo.hi)}, ${fint(meshCo.N)} entries in ${meshCo.G} concepts.`;
const fState={tab:"folds",spec:"co",ct:true};
function forestRows(){
  const out=[];
  if(fState.tab==="folds"){
    for(const f of ["screen","heldout","mesh"]){
      const a=get(f,fState.spec,"A");out.push({label:FOLDNAME[f],sub:`N ${fint(a.N)}, G ${a.G}`,r:a,kind:"A"});
      if(fState.ct){out.push({label:"",sub:"",r:get(f,fState.spec,"CT"),kind:"CT",of:FOLDNAME[f]});}
    }
    if(fState.spec==="co"){const v=FOREST.ivw;out.push({label:"Pooled (IVW)",sub:`I² ${v.I2.toFixed(0)}`,r:Object.assign({fold:"ivw",src:v.src},v),kind:"IVW"});}
  } else if(fState.tab==="origin"){
    for(const o of FOREST.origin){out.push({label:o.group==="other"?"Other fields":o.group==="CS"?"Computer Science":"Physics & Astronomy",sub:`N ${fint(o.N)}, G ${o.G}`,r:Object.assign({src:FOREST.origin_meta.src},o),kind:"A"});}
  } else {
    for(const f of ["screen","heldout","mesh"]){const a=get(f,"co","A");const p=FOREST.placebo.find(x=>x.fold===f);
      out.push({label:FOLDNAME[f],sub:"",r:a,kind:"A"});out.push({label:"",sub:"",r:p,kind:"PL",of:FOLDNAME[f]});}
  }
  return out;}
function drawForest(){
  const host=$("#forest-chart");const W=widthOf(host);const rows=forestRows();const narrow=W<520;
  const probe=newSvg(host,W,10,"");
  const labW=Math.max(...rows.map(r=>Math.max(textW(probe,r.label,13,600),textW(probe,r.sub,11))))+14;
  const valW=narrow?0:Math.max(...rows.map(r=>textW(probe,valStr(r),12)))+12;
  const rowH=rows.map(r=>r.kind==="A"||r.kind==="IVW"?30:24);const top=10,bottom=48;
  const H=top+rowH.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)+bottom;const L=labW,R=W-valW-8;
  const svg=newSvg(host,W,H,"Forest plot of incidence-rate ratios per SD");
  const lo=0.55,hi=2.1;const x=v=>L+(Math.log(v)-Math.log(lo))/(Math.log(hi)-Math.log(lo))*(R-L);
  const ticks=[0.6,0.8,1,1.25,1.5,2];const ax=S("g",{class:"axis"},svg);
  ticks.forEach(t=>{S("line",{x1:x(t),x2:x(t),y1:top,y2:H-bottom,class:"gridl"},ax);const tx=S("text",{x:x(t),y:H-bottom+16,"text-anchor":"middle"},ax);tx.textContent=String(t);});
  S("line",{x1:L,x2:R,y1:H-bottom,y2:H-bottom},ax);
  const at=S("text",{x:(L+R)/2,y:H-8,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":12},ax);at.textContent="IRR per SD (log scale)";
  S("line",{x1:x(1),x2:x(1),y1:top-4,y2:H-bottom,stroke:"#555","stroke-dasharray":"4 3"},svg);
  let y=top;
  rows.forEach((row,i)=>{const h=rowH[i];const cy=y+h/2;const r=row.r;
    if(row.label){const t=S("text",{x:0,y:cy+(row.sub?-2:4),"font-size":13,"font-weight":600},svg);t.textContent=row.label;
      if(row.sub){const s=S("text",{x:0,y:cy+12,"font-size":11,fill:"#6b7079"},svg);s.textContent=row.sub;}}
    const col=row.kind==="A"?"var(--accent)":row.kind==="IVW"?"var(--orange)":"var(--base)";
    const g=S("g",{},svg);
    S("rect",{class:"hit",x:L,y:y+1,width:R-L,height:h-2,rx:4},g);
    const a=Math.max(lo,r.lo),b=Math.min(hi,r.hi);
    S("line",{x1:x(a),x2:x(b),y1:cy,y2:cy,stroke:col,"stroke-width":row.kind==="A"?2.5:2},g);
    if(row.kind==="A"){S("circle",{cx:x(r.est),cy,r:6,fill:fState.spec==="pri"&&fState.tab==="folds"?"#fff":col,stroke:col,"stroke-width":2.5},g);}
    else{const s=row.kind==="IVW"?7:5.5;S("path",{d:`M${x(r.est)} ${cy-s} L${x(r.est)+s} ${cy} L${x(r.est)} ${cy+s} L${x(r.est)-s} ${cy} Z`,fill:col},g);}
    if(!narrow){const vt=S("text",{x:W-4,y:cy+4,"text-anchor":"end","font-size":12,fill:"#4a4e55"},svg);vt.textContent=valStr(row);}
    bindMark(g,()=>tipHtml(row),ariaStr(row));
    y+=h;});
}
function whatOf(row){return row.kind==="CT"?"Co-transfer":row.kind==="PL"?"Placebo host":row.kind==="IVW"?"Host share, pooled":"Host share";}
function valStr(row){const r=row.r;let s=`${f2(r.est)} [${f2(r.lo)}, ${f2(r.hi)}]`;if(r.p!=null&&row.kind!=="PL") s+=`  p ${fp(r.p)}`;return s;}
function ariaStr(row){return `${row.of||row.label}, ${whatOf(row)}: IRR ${valStr(row)}`;}
function tipHtml(row){const r=row.r;const fold=row.of||row.label;let h=`<b>${esc(fold)}: ${whatOf(row)}</b><br>IRR per SD ${f3(r.est)} (95% ${row.kind==="PL"&&r.kind==="median of placebo draws"?"range of draws":"CI"} ${f3(r.lo)} to ${f3(r.hi)})`;
  if(r.p!=null) h+=`<br>p = ${fp(r.p)}`;if(r.pw!=null) h+=`, wild-cluster p = ${r.pw}`;if(r.N) h+=`<br>N = ${fint(r.N)} events`+(r.G?`, G = ${r.G} concept clusters`:"");
  if(r.kind) h+=`<br>${esc(r.kind)}`;h+=`<span class="src">${esc(r.src||"")}</span>`;return h;}
function forestTake(){
  if(fState.tab==="folds"){
    const A=["screen","heldout","mesh"].map(f=>get(f,fState.spec,"A"));const sig=A.filter(a=>a.lo>1);
    const C=["screen","heldout","mesh"].map(f=>get(f,fState.spec,"CT"));const cnull=C.filter(c=>c.lo<=1&&c.hi>=1).length;
    if(fState.spec==="co") return `Under the co-primary fixed effects, host share raises newcomer uptake on all ${sig.length} populations (Screen ${f2(A[0].est)}, Held-out ${f2(A[1].est)}, MeSH ${f2(A[2].est)}; pooled ${f2(FOREST.ivw.est)} [${f2(FOREST.ivw.lo)}, ${f2(FOREST.ivw.hi)}]), while co-transfer's interval includes 1 on ${cnull} of 3.`;
    const ho=A[1];return `Under the stricter primary fixed effects the Held-out fold keeps only ${ho.N} events in ${ho.G} clusters and is inconclusive (${f2(ho.est)} [${f2(ho.lo)}, ${f2(ho.hi)}]); MeSH stays significant (${f2(A[2].est)} [${f2(A[2].lo)}, ${f2(A[2].hi)}]) and ${sig.length} of 3 intervals exclude 1.`;
  }
  if(fState.tab==="origin"){const m=FOREST.origin_meta;const ph=FOREST.origin.find(o=>o.group==="Physics/Astro");
    return `Pooling Screen and Held-out, the effect is similar across origin fields (Wald p = ${m.wald_p.toFixed(2)}, label-permutation p = ${m.perm_p.toFixed(2)}); Physics & Astronomy alone is not significant (${f2(ph.est)} [${f2(ph.lo)}, ${f2(ph.hi)}]) but sits within sampling variation of the others.`;}
  const pl=FOREST.placebo;return `Assigning each entry the share computed for a different host gives estimates centred on 1 (${pl.map(p=>FOLDNAME[p.fold]+" "+f2(p.est)).join(", ")}), so the effect belongs to the actual host, not to generic partner properties.`;
}
function renderForest(){drawForest();$("#forest-take").textContent=forestTake();
  const lg=$("#forest-legend");
  if(fState.tab==="folds") lg.innerHTML=`<span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--accent);border-radius:50%;width:11px;height:11px"></i>host-vocabulary share</span>`+(fState.ct?`<span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--base);transform:rotate(45deg);width:9px;height:9px"></i>co-transfer (competing regressor)</span>`:"")+(fState.spec==="co"?`<span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--orange);transform:rotate(45deg);width:10px;height:10px"></i>IVW pooled</span>`:`<span>open circles: primary FE</span>`);
  else if(fState.tab==="origin") lg.innerHTML=`<span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--accent)"></i>host share, by concept's origin field (pooled Screen + Held-out, co-primary FE)</span>`;
  else lg.innerHTML=`<span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--accent)"></i>actual host share (co-primary)</span><span><i class="sw" style="background:var(--base)"></i>placebo host</span>`;}
$$("#forest-tabs [role=tab]").forEach((t,i,all)=>{
  t.addEventListener("click",()=>selectTab(t));
  t.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{let j=null;if(e.key==="ArrowRight") j=(i+1)%all.length;if(e.key==="ArrowLeft") j=(i-1+all.length)%all.length;if(e.key==="Home") j=0;if(e.key==="End") j=all.length-1;if(j!=null){e.preventDefault();all[j].focus();selectTab(all[j]);}});});
function selectTab(t){$$("#forest-tabs [role=tab]").forEach(x=>{const on=x===t;x.setAttribute("aria-selected",on);x.tabIndex=on?0:-1;});
  fState.tab=t.dataset.tab;$("#forest-panel").setAttribute("aria-labelledby",t.id);$("#forest-controls").style.display=fState.tab==="folds"?"":"none";renderForest();}
$$('input[name=spec]').forEach(r=>r.addEventListener("change",()=>{fState.spec=r.value;renderForest();}));
$("#show-ct").addEventListener("change",e=>{fState.ct=e.target.checked;renderForest();});
onResize(drawForest,$("#forest-chart"));

// =====================================================================
// 2. STEPPER
const E=STEP.event,C=STEP.concept;const scrA=ASORT.screen;const aPct=pctRank(scrA,E.A_cont);
const cutY=C.F;const W2=[E.e+1,E.e+5];
const STAGES=[
 {k:"Concept",t:`1. An emerging concept enters the pool`,
  i:`Noun phrases first used in OpenAlex titles and abstracts in 2005 to 2016, frozen and hashed before any later data were read.`,
  d:`Surface forms are matched to works (<em>${esc(C.surface_forms.join("; "))}</em>). The origin subfield is where the concept started.`,
  o:`<dl class="kv"><dt>Concept</dt><dd>${esc(title(C.phrase))}</dd><dt>First year (F)</dt><dd>${C.F}</dd><dt>Origin</dt><dd>${esc(C.origin_subfield)}</dd><dt>Diffusion type</dt><dd>${C.type==="BROAD"?"broad from the start":"localised"}</dd></dl>`,
  w:`Freezing the pool before outcomes are known keeps the sample from favouring concepts that later succeeded.`,draw:drawYearly},
 {k:"Entry",t:`2. The concept enters a new host subfield`,
  i:`Every work that carries the concept, with its OpenAlex primary subfield and year.`,
  d:`Find the first year the concept appears in a non-origin subfield with at least five co-occurring partner terms.`,
  o:`<dl class="kv"><dt>Host</dt><dd>${esc(E.host)}</dd><dt>Entry year (e)</dt><dd>${E.e}</dd><dt>Entry papers</dt><dd>${E.n_entry_papers}</dd><dt>Entry authors</dt><dd>${E.n_entry_authors}</dd><dt>Distinct partners</dt><dd>${E.n_partners_distinct} (${E.n_partner_tags} tags)</dd></dl>`,
  w:`The entry, not the concept, is the unit: one concept can enter many hosts, and fixed effects compare its entries with each other.`,draw:drawEntries},
 {k:"Partners",t:`3. Each partner term gets a host profile`,
  i:`The ${E.n_partner_tags} partner tags on the entry papers, and exact OpenAlex subfield-by-period publication counts for each partner term.`,
  d:`For every partner, compute the share of its pre-entry publications that sit in the host subfield. Classify tags at a 0.3 host-share cut as native or not, and as origin companions or not.`,
  o:`Profiles cover ${pct(E.cov)} of this entry's partner tags. At the 0.3 cut: ${pct(E.graft_t03)} native grafts, ${pct(E.native_companion_t03)} native companions, ${pct(E.package_t03)} non-native origin companions, ${pct(E.third_party_t03)} other non-native partners.`,
  w:`A partner that is already common in the host is vocabulary the host's researchers can read.`,draw:drawTags},
 {k:"Share",t:`4. Partners reduce to two numbers: host share and co-transfer`,
  i:`Per-partner host shares and association-strength weights; the concept's origin companions in the five years before entry.`,
  d:`Host-vocabulary share = tag-weighted mean of partner host shares. Co-transfer = fraction of partners that were origin companions in [e−5, e−1].`,
  o:`<dl class="kv"><dt>Host share</dt><dd>${E.A_cont.toFixed(3)} (higher than ${pct(aPct)} of 1,740 Screen entries)</dd><dt>Co-transfer</dt><dd>${E.CT.toFixed(2)}</dd></dl>`,
  w:`Only 1.1% of partner tags have a host share above 50%, so the continuous share is the pre-registered exposure rather than a native/non-native count.`,draw:drawHist},
 {k:"Uptake",t:`5. Count newcomer papers over the next five years`,
  i:`All host-subfield papers on the concept from ${W2[0]} to ${W2[1]}, with their author lists.`,
  d:`Keep papers by authors with no prior concept paper and no co-authorship with concept authors.`,
  o:`<dl class="kv"><dt>Newcomer papers</dt><dd>${E.Y} (all host papers ${E.Y_all})</dd><dt>By year</dt><dd>${E.yt.join(", ")}</dd><dt>Rooted</dt><dd>${E.EST?"yes":"no"}</dd></dl>`,
  w:`Counting only newcomers separates adoption by the host community from the original authors continuing their own line of work.`,draw:drawUptake},
 {k:"Model",t:`6. Regress uptake on host share across all entries`,
  i:`1,544 Screen entries in 140 concepts, each with host share, co-transfer and controls (relatedness, momentum, volume and others).`,
  d:`PPML with concept, entry-year and host fixed effects; standard errors clustered by concept. For a descriptive check, 5-fold out-of-fold predictions by concept compare a controls-only model with one that adds host share and co-transfer.`,
  o:`Coefficient b = ${STEP.b_screen.toFixed(3)} per unit share; SD = ${STEP.sd_screen.toFixed(4)}; IRR per SD = e<sup>b·SD</sup> = <strong id="irr-live"></strong>. For this entry: baseline ${E.pb.toFixed(1)}, method ${E.pm.toFixed(1)}, observed ${E.Y}.`,
  w:`The fixed effects mean the estimate compares entries of the same concept, in the same year cohort and host, which removes concept quality as an explanation.`,draw:drawModel}
];
let cur=0;
function drawPipe(){const host=$("#pipe");const W=widthOf(host);const n=STAGES.length;const gap=W<520?6:14;const bw=(W-gap*(n-1))/n;const H=W<520?52:56;
  const svg=newSvg(host,W,H,"Pipeline with six stages");svg.removeAttribute("role");svg.setAttribute("aria-hidden","false");
  STAGES.forEach((s,i)=>{const x=i*(bw+gap);
    if(i>0){S("path",{d:`M${x-gap+1} ${H/2} L${x-1} ${H/2}`,stroke:"#9a9ea5","stroke-width":1.5},svg);}
    const g=S("g",{class:"node"+(i<cur?" done":""),tabindex:0,role:"button","aria-label":`Stage ${i+1}: ${s.k}`},svg);
    if(i===cur) g.setAttribute("aria-current","step");
    S("rect",{x,y:4,width:bw,height:H-8,rx:7},g);
    const fs=W<420?10.5:W<620?12:13.5;const t=S("text",{x:x+bw/2,y:H/2+4,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":fs},g);t.textContent=(W<420?"":(i+1)+". ")+s.k;
    g.addEventListener("click",()=>go(i));g.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Enter"||e.key===" "){e.preventDefault();go(i);}});});}
function go(i,focusPipe){cur=Math.max(0,Math.min(STAGES.length-1,i));const s=STAGES[cur];
  $("#step-title").textContent=s.t;$("#step-in").innerHTML=s.i;$("#step-do").innerHTML=s.d;$("#step-out").innerHTML=s.o;$("#step-why").innerHTML="<strong>Why:</strong> "+s.w;
  $("#step-prev").disabled=cur===0;$("#step-next").disabled=cur===STAGES.length-1;$("#step-count").textContent=`Stage ${cur+1} of ${STAGES.length}`;
  $("#step-live").textContent=`Stage ${cur+1} of ${STAGES.length}: ${s.t}`;
  const il=$("#irr-live");if(il) il.textContent=Math.exp(STEP.b_screen*STEP.sd_screen).toFixed(2);
  drawPipe();s.draw();hideTip();}
$("#step-prev").addEventListener("click",()=>go(cur-1));$("#step-next").addEventListener("click",()=>go(cur+1));
$("#stepper").addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.target.matches("input,select,textarea")) return;if(e.key==="ArrowRight"){e.preventDefault();go(cur+1);}if(e.key==="ArrowLeft"){e.preventDefault();go(cur-1);}});
function barChart(host,items,opt){ // vertical bars from zero
  const W=widthOf(host);const H=opt.h||190;const probe=newSvg(host,W,10,"");
  const maxV=opt.max||Math.max(...items.map(d=>d.v))*1.12;const ticks=niceTicks(0,maxV,4);
  const tw=Math.max(...ticks.map(t=>textW(probe,opt.tf?opt.tf(t):String(t),12)));
  const L=tw+30,R=W-8,T=14,B=H-(opt.xlab?44:26);
  const svg=newSvg(host,W,H,opt.label);const y=v=>B-(v/ticks[ticks.length-1])*(B-T);const ax=S("g",{class:"axis"},svg);
  ticks.forEach(t=>{S("line",{x1:L,x2:R,y1:y(t),y2:y(t),class:"gridl"},ax);const tx=S("text",{x:L-6,y:y(t)+4,"text-anchor":"end"},ax);tx.textContent=opt.tf?opt.tf(t):t;});
  const yl=S("text",{transform:`translate(12 ${(T+B)/2}) rotate(-90)`,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":12},ax);yl.textContent=opt.ylab;
  if(opt.xlab){const xl=S("text",{x:(L+R)/2,y:H-6,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":12},ax);xl.textContent=opt.xlab;}
  const bw=(R-L)/items.length;const showEvery=Math.ceil(items.length/Math.max(1,Math.floor((R-L)/34)));
  items.forEach((d,i)=>{const g=S("g",{},svg);const x0=L+i*bw;S("rect",{class:"hit",x:x0,y:T,width:bw,height:B-T},g);
    S("rect",{x:x0+bw*0.14,y:y(d.v),width:bw*0.72,height:Math.max(0,B-y(d.v)),fill:d.c||"var(--accent)",rx:2},g);
    if(i%showEvery===0||items.length<12){const t=S("text",{x:x0+bw/2,y:B+15,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":11,fill:"#4a4e55"},ax);t.textContent=d.l;}
    if(opt.values){const t=S("text",{x:x0+bw/2,y:y(d.v)-5,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":12,"font-weight":600},svg);t.textContent=opt.vf?opt.vf(d.v):d.v;}
    bindMark(g,d.tip,d.aria||`${d.l}: ${d.v}`);});
  S("line",{x1:L,x2:R,y1:B,y2:B,stroke:"#9a9ea5"},ax);
  return svg;}
function niceTicks(a,b,n){const span=b-a||1;const step0=span/n;const mag=Math.pow(10,Math.floor(Math.log10(step0)));const err=step0/mag;const step=(err>=5?10:err>=2?5:err>=1.5?2:1)*mag;const out=[];for(let v=0;v<=b+step*0.999;v+=step) out.push(+v.toFixed(10));return out;}
function drawYearly(){const yrs=Object.keys(C.yearly).filter(y=>+y>=2005);
  barChart($("#step-chart"),yrs.map(y=>({l:"’"+y.slice(2),v:C.yearly[y],c:+y===C.F?"var(--orange)":+y>=E.e+1&&+y<=E.e+5?"var(--accent)":"#a9c6e3",tip:`<b>${y}</b><br>${C.yearly[y]} OpenAlex works mention the concept`+(+y===C.F?"<br>first year (F)":""),aria:`${y}: ${C.yearly[y]} works`})),
  {label:"Works per year mentioning the concept",ylab:"works per year",xlab:"year (orange: first year; blue: outcome window of the AI entry)",h:200});}
function drawEntries(){const host=$("#step-chart");const es=STEP.other_entries.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.e-b.e||b.A-a.A);
  hbar(host,es.map(o=>({label:`${o.host}, ${o.e}`,v:o.A,c:o.EST?"var(--green)":"var(--base)",hl:o.host===E.host&&o.e===E.e,tip:`<b>${esc(o.host)}, ${o.e}</b><br>host share ${o.A.toFixed(3)}, co-transfer ${o.CT.toFixed(2)}<br>newcomer papers ${o.Y}${o.EST?" (rooted)":""}`})),
  {xlab:"host-vocabulary share",label:"All recorded entries of EPR steering, by year"});}
function drawTags(){const parts=[["native graft",E.graft_t03,"var(--green)"],["native origin companion",E.native_companion_t03,"#6fbf9f"],["non-native origin companion",E.package_t03,"var(--orange)"],["other non-native partner",E.third_party_t03,"var(--base)"]];
  barChart($("#step-chart"),parts.map(p=>({l:p[0].split(" ").slice(-1)[0],v:p[1],c:p[2],tip:`<b>${p[0]}</b><br>${pct(p[1])} of profiled partner tags`,aria:`${p[0]}: ${pct(p[1])}`})),
  {label:"Partner tag classes at a 0.3 host-share cut",ylab:"share of profiled tags",xlab:"graft | native companion | origin package | other non-native",max:1,tf:t=>pct(t),values:true,vf:v=>pct(v),h:210});}
function drawHist(){const bins=[];const step=0.02;for(let b=0;b<0.3;b+=step){bins.push({a:b,b:b+step,n:0});}const over={a:0.3,b:Infinity,n:0};
  for(const v of scrA){if(v>=0.3) over.n++;else bins[Math.min(bins.length-1,Math.floor(v/step))].n++;}bins.push(over);
  barChart($("#step-chart"),bins.map(bn=>{const has=E.A_cont>=bn.a&&E.A_cont<bn.b;const lab=bn.b===Infinity?"0.30+":bn.a.toFixed(2);
    return {l:lab,v:bn.n,c:has?"var(--orange)":"#a9c6e3",tip:`<b>host share ${bn.b===Infinity?"≥ 0.30":bn.a.toFixed(2)+" to "+bn.b.toFixed(2)}</b><br>${bn.n} Screen entries`+(has?`<br>EPR steering → AI (${E.A_cont.toFixed(3)}) is here`:""),aria:`${lab}: ${bn.n} entries`};}),
  {label:"Distribution of host share over Screen entries",ylab:"Screen entries",xlab:"host-vocabulary share (orange bin: this entry)",h:210});}
function drawUptake(){barChart($("#step-chart"),E.yt.map((v,i)=>({l:String(E.e+1+i),v,c:v>=5?"var(--green)":"var(--accent)",tip:`<b>${E.e+1+i}</b><br>${v} newcomer papers`+(v>=5?" (5 or more)":""),aria:`${E.e+1+i}: ${v} newcomer papers`})),
  {label:"Newcomer papers per year after entry",ylab:"newcomer papers",xlab:"outcome year (green: 5 or more newcomer papers)",values:true,h:200});}
function drawModel(){barChart($("#step-chart"),[{l:"baseline",v:E.pb,c:"var(--base)",tip:`<b>Controls-only model</b><br>out-of-fold prediction ${E.pb.toFixed(2)}`},{l:"method",v:E.pm,c:"var(--accent)",tip:`<b>+ host share and co-transfer</b><br>out-of-fold prediction ${E.pm.toFixed(2)}`},{l:"observed",v:E.Y,c:"var(--green)",tip:`<b>Observed</b><br>${E.Y} newcomer papers`}],
  {label:"Predicted and observed newcomer papers for this entry",ylab:"newcomer papers",values:true,vf:v=>v.toFixed(v%1?1:0),h:200});}
onResize(()=>{drawPipe();STAGES[cur].draw();},$("#stepper"));

// horizontal bar chart (labels measured; stacked labels when narrow)
function hbar(host,items,opt){const W=widthOf(host);const probe=newSvg(host,W,10,"");
  const narrow=W<560;const labW=narrow?0:Math.min(W*0.45,Math.max(...items.map(d=>textW(probe,d.label,12)))+12);
  const rowH=narrow?38:24;const T=6,B=40;const H=T+items.length*rowH+B;const L=labW+4,R=W-54;
  const svg=newSvg(host,W,H,opt.label);const maxV=Math.max(opt.max||0,...items.map(d=>d.v))*1.05||0.1;const ticks=niceTicks(0,maxV,4);const top=ticks[ticks.length-1];
  const x=v=>L+v/top*(R-L);const ax=S("g",{class:"axis"},svg);
  ticks.forEach(t=>{S("line",{x1:x(t),x2:x(t),y1:T,y2:H-B,class:"gridl"},ax);const tx=S("text",{x:x(t),y:H-B+15,"text-anchor":"middle"},ax);tx.textContent=t;});
  const xl=S("text",{x:(L+R)/2,y:H-6,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":12},ax);xl.textContent=opt.xlab;
  items.forEach((d,i)=>{const y0=T+i*rowH;const g=S("g",{},svg);S("rect",{class:"hit",x:0,y:y0,width:W,height:rowH},g);
    const by=narrow?y0+18:y0+4,bh=narrow?16:rowH-8;
    let lab=d.label;if(!narrow){while(textW(probe,lab,12)>labW-8&&lab.length>6) lab=lab.slice(0,-2);if(lab!==d.label) lab=lab.replace(/.$/,"…");}
    const t=S("text",{x:narrow?L:labW-6,y:narrow?y0+13:y0+rowH/2+4,"text-anchor":narrow?"start":"end","font-size":12,"font-weight":d.hl?700:400},svg);t.textContent=lab;
    S("rect",{x:L,y:by,width:Math.max(1.5,x(d.v)-L),height:bh,fill:d.c,rx:2,stroke:d.hl?"var(--ink)":"none","stroke-width":d.hl?1.5:0},g);
    const vt=S("text",{x:x(d.v)+5,y:by+bh/2+4,"font-size":11,fill:"#4a4e55"},svg);vt.textContent=d.v.toFixed(3);
    bindMark(g,d.tip,`${d.label}: ${d.v.toFixed(3)}`);});

// =====================================================================
// 3a. CONCEPT VIEW
const byConcept={};for(const f of ["screen","heldout","mesh"]) for(const r of ROWS[f]){(byConcept[r.c]=byConcept[r.c]||{fold:f,rows:[]}).rows.push(r);}
const csel=$("#concept-sel");
for(const f of ["screen","heldout","mesh"]){const og=document.createElement("optgroup");og.label=FOLDNAME[f]+" concepts with 3+ entries";
  Object.keys(byConcept).filter(c=>byConcept[c].fold===f&&byConcept[c].rows.length>=3).sort((a,b)=>cname(a).localeCompare(cname(b))).forEach(c=>{const o=document.createElement("option");o.value=c;o.textContent=`${cname(c)} (${byConcept[c].rows.length})`;og.appendChild(o);});
  csel.appendChild(og);}
const caseIds=[...new Set(CASES.map(c=>c.cid))];
caseIds.forEach(id=>{const b=document.createElement("button");b.type="button";b.textContent=title(CASES.find(c=>c.cid===id).phrase).replace("Einstein Podolsky Rosen","EPR").replace("Qcd","QCD");b.dataset.cid=id;b.setAttribute("aria-pressed","false");
  b.addEventListener("click",()=>{if(!csel.querySelector(`option[value="${id}"]`)){const o=document.createElement("option");o.value=id;o.textContent=`${cname(id)} (${(byConcept[id]||{rows:[]}).rows.length})`;csel.firstChild.appendChild(o);}csel.value=id;renderConcept();});$("#case-btns").appendChild(b);});
csel.value="c_9cceb3c510be";csel.addEventListener("change",renderConcept);
function renderConcept(){const id=csel.value;const bc=byConcept[id];const rows=bc.rows.slice().sort((a,b)=>b.A-a.A);
  $$("#case-btns button").forEach(b=>b.setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(b.dataset.cid===id)));
  const non=rows.filter(r=>!r.est);const meanNon=non.length?non.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.A,0)/non.length:null;
  hbar($("#concept-chart"),rows.map(r=>({label:`${sname(r.d)}, ${r.e}`,v:r.A,c:r.est?"var(--green)":"var(--base)",tip:`<b>${esc(sname(r.d))}, ${r.e}</b><br>host share ${r.A.toFixed(3)}, co-transfer ${r.CT.toFixed(2)}<br>${r.npart} partners, ${r.npap} entry paper${r.npap>1?"s":""}<br>newcomer papers ${r.Y}${r.est?" (rooted)":""}`})),{xlab:"host-vocabulary share",label:`Host entries of ${cname(id)}`,ref:meanNon});
  const rooted=rows.filter(r=>r.est);const name=cname(id);let t;
  if(!rooted.length) t=`None of the ${rows.length} recorded entries of “${name}” (${FOLDNAME[bc.fold]}) took root; their mean host share is ${meanNon.toFixed(3)}.`;
  else{const top=rows[0];const mr=rooted.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.A,0)/rooted.length;
    t=`${rooted.length} of ${rows.length} entries of “${name}” (${FOLDNAME[bc.fold]}) took root, with mean host share ${mr.toFixed(3)} against ${meanNon!=null?meanNon.toFixed(3):"n/a"} for the rest; the highest-share entry (${sname(top.d)}, ${top.e}) ${top.est?"is":"is not"} rooted.`;}
  const cs=CASES.filter(c=>c.cid===id&&c.coprimary);if(cs.length&&cs.length!==rows.length) t+=` The paper's panel keeps the ${cs.length} entries in the co-primary sample; this view shows all ${rows.length} with five or more partners.`;
  $("#concept-take").textContent=t;}

// =====================================================================
// 3b. ENTRY BROWSER
const bState={fold:"screen",q:"",filter:"all",sort:"A",limit:40,sel:null};
function dev(y,m){return 2*((y>0?y*Math.log(y/m):0)-(y-m));}
function browserRows(){const rows=ROWS[bState.fold];const q=bState.q.trim().toLowerCase();const hiCut=quantile(ASORT[bState.fold],0.8);
  let out=rows.filter(r=>{if(q&&!(cname(r.c).toLowerCase().includes(q)||sname(r.d).toLowerCase().includes(q))) return false;
    if(bState.filter==="rooted"&&!r.est) return false;if(bState.filter==="zero"&&r.Y!==0) return false;if(bState.filter==="hi0"&&!(r.A>=hiCut&&r.Y===0)) return false;return true;});
  const key={A:r=>-r.A,Y:r=>-r.Y,gain:r=>dev(r.Y,r.pm)-dev(r.Y,r.pb),loss:r=>dev(r.Y,r.pb)-dev(r.Y,r.pm)}[bState.sort];
  out=out.map(r=>[key(r),r]).sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]).map(x=>x[1]);return out;}
function renderBrowser(){const rows=browserRows();const tb=$("#br-table tbody");tb.innerHTML="";
  rows.slice(0,bState.limit).forEach(r=>{const tr=document.createElement("tr");if(bState.sel===r) tr.className="sel";
    tr.innerHTML=`<td><button type="button" class="rowbtn">${esc(cname(r.c))}</button></td><td>${esc(sname(r.d))}, ${r.e}</td><td class="num">${r.A.toFixed(3)}</td><td class="num">${r.Y}${r.est?' <span class="pill ok">rooted</span>':""}</td>`;
    tr.querySelector("button").addEventListener("click",()=>{bState.sel=r;renderBrowser();});tb.appendChild(tr);});
  $("#br-more").style.display=rows.length>bState.limit?"":"none";
  const all=ROWS[bState.fold];const nRooted=rows.filter(r=>r.est).length;
  $("#br-status").innerHTML=`<span class="count">${fint(rows.length)}</span> of ${fint(all.length)} ${FOLDNAME[bState.fold]} entries match; ${fint(nRooted)} of them rooted. Showing ${Math.min(rows.length,bState.limit)}.`;
  if(!bState.sel||bState.sel.fold!==bState.fold||!rows.includes(bState.sel)) bState.sel=rows[0]||null;
  renderDetail();
  // takeaway: how often method beats baseline in current selection
  const better=rows.filter(r=>dev(r.Y,r.pm)<dev(r.Y,r.pb)).length;
  const mB=rows.reduce((s,r)=>s+dev(r.Y,r.pb),0)/Math.max(1,rows.length),mM=rows.reduce((s,r)=>s+dev(r.Y,r.pm),0)/Math.max(1,rows.length);
  $("#br-take").textContent=rows.length?`In this selection the model with host share is closer to the observed count for ${fint(better)} of ${fint(rows.length)} entries (${pct(better/rows.length)}); mean Poisson deviance ${mM.toFixed(2)} versus ${mB.toFixed(2)} for the baseline.`+(bState.q||bState.filter!=="all"?"":oosNote()):"No entry matches this search.";}
function oosNote(){const m=EV[bState.fold].meta.oos;if(!m) return "";
  if(bState.fold==="screen") return ` The run's record for all ${fint(m.n_events)} Screen entries: ${m.mean_deviance_M1.toFixed(2)} versus ${m.mean_deviance_M0.toFixed(2)}, difference ${f2(m.deviance_diff_M1_minus_M0)} (95% CI ${f2(m.deviance_diff_ci95_concept_bootstrap[0])} to ${f2(m.deviance_diff_ci95_concept_bootstrap[1])}), a descriptive check only.`;
  if(bState.fold==="mesh") return ` The run's record for all ${fint(m.n_events)} MeSH entries: ${m.mean_deviance_method.toFixed(2)} versus ${m.mean_deviance_baseline.toFixed(2)}, difference ${f2(m.deviance_diff_method_minus_baseline)} (95% CI ${f2(m.deviance_diff_ci95_concept_bootstrap[0])} to ${f2(m.deviance_diff_ci95_concept_bootstrap[1])}).`;
  return " On the Held-out fold the method is the co-primary model fitted on Screen; the paper reports its out-of-sample deviance gain as descriptive only.";}
function renderDetail(){const r=bState.sel;const box=$("#br-detail");if(!r){box.innerHTML="<p>No entry selected.</p>";return;}
  const pr=pctRank(ASORT[r.fold],r.A);const c=NAMES.concepts[r.c]||{};
  box.innerHTML=`<h4 style="margin:0 0 4px;font-size:1.05rem">${esc(cname(r.c))} <span class="pill">${FOLDNAME[r.fold]}</span></h4>
  <p class="small" style="margin:0 0 8px">enters <strong>${esc(sname(r.d))}</strong> in ${r.e}, from ${esc(sname(r.o))}${c.F?`; first year ${c.F}`:""}${c.t?`; ${c.t==="BROAD"?"broad":"localised"} type`:""}</p>
  <dl class="kv"><dt>Input: partners</dt><dd>${r.npart} distinct, ${r.npap} entry paper${r.npap>1?"s":""}</dd><dt>Input: host share</dt><dd>${r.A.toFixed(3)} (above ${pct(pr)} of ${FOLDNAME[r.fold]} entries)</dd><dt>Input: co-transfer</dt><dd>${r.CT.toFixed(2)}</dd></dl>
  <div class="cmp"><div><div class="l">Baseline prediction (controls only)</div><div class="v">${r.pb.toFixed(1)}</div></div><div><div class="l">Method prediction (+ host share, co-transfer)</div><div class="v" style="color:var(--accent)">${r.pm.toFixed(1)}</div></div><div><div class="l">Observed newcomer papers</div><div class="v" style="color:var(--green)">${r.Y}</div></div></div>
  <div class="chart" id="br-mini"></div>
  <p class="small" style="margin:6px 0 0">${r.est?'<span class="pill ok">rooted</span> ':'<span class="pill no">not rooted</span> '}Method is ${Math.abs(r.pm-r.Y)<Math.abs(r.pb-r.Y)?"closer to":"further from"} the observed count than the baseline.</p>`;
  barChart($("#br-mini"),r.yt.map((v,i)=>({l:String(r.e+1+i),v,c:v>=5?"var(--green)":"var(--accent)",tip:`<b>${r.e+1+i}</b><br>${v} newcomer papers`,aria:`${r.e+1+i}: ${v}`})),{label:"Newcomer papers per outcome year",ylab:"newcomer papers",max:Math.max(4,...r.yt)*1.15,values:true,h:150});}
$("#br-fold").addEventListener("change",e=>{bState.fold=e.target.value;bState.limit=40;bState.sel=null;renderBrowser();});

const OUTLAB={Any:"≥1 paper",Y_ge3:"≥3 papers",Y_ge5:"≥5 papers",EST_bin:"rooted"};

  const host=$("#mg-chart");const W=widthOf(host);const H=240;const probe=newSvg(host,W,10,"");
  const lo=Math.min(-2,...rows.map(r=>r.lo)),hi=Math.max(...rows.map(r=>r.hi))*1.08;const ticks=[];for(let t=Math.ceil(lo/2)*2;t<=hi;t+=2) ticks.push(t);
  const tw=Math.max(...ticks.map(t=>textW(probe,String(t),12)));const L=tw+34,R=W-8,T=18,B=H-44;
  const svg=newSvg(host,W,H,"Extensive-margin effects by uptake threshold");const y=v=>B-(v-ticks[0])/(ticks[ticks.length-1]-ticks[0])*(B-T);const ax=S("g",{class:"axis"},svg);
  ticks.forEach(t=>{S("line",{x1:L,x2:R,y1:y(t),y2:y(t),class:"gridl"},ax);const tx=S("text",{x:L-6,y:y(t)+4,"text-anchor":"end"},ax);tx.textContent=t<0?MINUS+Math.abs(t):t;});
  S("line",{x1:L,x2:R,y1:y(0),y2:y(0),stroke:"#555"},svg);
  const yl=S("text",{transform:`translate(12 ${(T+B)/2}) rotate(-90)`,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":12},ax);yl.textContent="pp per SD of host share";
  const xl=S("text",{x:(L+R)/2,y:H-6,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":12},ax);xl.textContent="outcome: reached at least … newcomer papers (share of entries in brackets)";
  const bw=(R-L)/rows.length;
  rows.forEach((r,i)=>{const g=S("g",{},svg);const x0=L+i*bw,cx=x0+bw/2;const sig=r.lo>0;const col=sig?"var(--accent)":"var(--base)";
    S("rect",{class:"hit",x:x0,y:T,width:bw,height:B-T},g);
    S("rect",{x:cx-bw*0.22,y:Math.min(y(r.est),y(0)),width:bw*0.44,height:Math.abs(y(r.est)-y(0)),fill:col,rx:2},g);
    S("line",{x1:cx,x2:cx,y1:y(r.lo),y2:y(r.hi),stroke:"var(--ink)","stroke-width":1.5},g);
    [r.lo,r.hi].forEach(v=>S("line",{x1:cx-6,x2:cx+6,y1:y(v),y2:y(v),stroke:"var(--ink)","stroke-width":1.5},g));
    const t=S("text",{x:cx,y:B+15,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":12},ax);t.textContent=`${OUTLAB[r.outcome]} (${pct(r.base)})`;
    if(W<440) t.setAttribute("font-size",10);
    const vt=S("text",{x:cx+bw*0.22+4,y:y(r.est)+4,"font-size":12,"font-weight":600},svg);vt.textContent=r.est.toFixed(2);
    bindMark(g,`<b>${FOLDNAME[fold.toLowerCase()]}: ${OUTLAB[r.outcome]}</b><br>${r.est.toFixed(2)} pp per SD (95% CI ${f2(r.lo)} to ${f2(r.hi)})<br>p = ${fp(r.p)}; base rate ${pct(r.base)}<br>N = ${fint(r.N)}, G = ${r.G}<span class="src">${esc(MARG.src.split(";")[0])}</span>`,`${OUTLAB[r.outcome]}: ${r.est.toFixed(2)} percentage points per SD`);});
  const kb=MARG.rows.find(r=>r.fold===fold&&r.test==="K1b");const iv=MARG.ivw;
  $("#mg-note").innerHTML=`Intensive margin on this population: IRR per SD ${f2(kb.est)} (95% CI ${f2(kb.lo)} to ${f2(kb.hi)}) among ${fint(kb.N)} entries with uptake. $$('input[name=mg]').forEach(r=>r.addEventListener("change",renderMargins));onResize(renderMargins,$("#mg-chart"));

// 4. TRY IT
function renderTry(){const fold=$("#try-fold").value;const p=+$("#try-cut").value/100;const k=+$("#try-k").value;const rows=ROWS[fold];
  const cut=quantile(ASORT[fold],p);$("#try-cut-val").textContent=`${Math.round(p*100)}th (share ≥ ${cut.toFixed(3)})`;$("#try-k-val").textContent=`k = ${k}`;
  const hiR=rows.filter(r=>r.A>=cut),loR=rows.filter(r=>r.A<cut);const rate=a=>a.filter(r=>r.Y>=k).length/Math.max(1,a.length);
  const rl=rate(loR),rh=rate(hiR),ra=rate(rows);const ml=loR.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.Y,0)/Math.max(1,loR.length),mh=hiR.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.Y,0)/Math.max(1,hiR.length);

    {l:`at or above (${fint(hiR.length)})`,v:rh,c:"var(--accent)",tip:`<b>Host share ≥ ${cut.toFixed(3)}</b><br>${fint(hiR.filter(r=>r.Y>=k).length)} of ${fint(hiR.length)} entries reached ${k}+ newcomer papers (${pct(rh)})<br>mean newcomer papers ${mh.toFixed(2)}`}],
    {label:"Share of entries reaching k newcomer papers, split at the cut-off",ylab:`share with ≥ ${k} newcomer papers`,max:Math.max(0.05,rl,rh,ra)*1.18,tf:t=>pct(t),values:true,vf:v=>(100*v).toFixed(1)+"%",h:230,xlab:"entries by host share (count)"});
  // overall reference line
  const ys=svg.querySelectorAll(".axis text");
  const B=+svg.querySelector(".axis line:last-of-type").getAttribute("y1");
  const gl=Array.from(svg.querySelectorAll(".gridl"));const t0=gl[0],tN=gl[gl.length-1];const yTop=+tN.getAttribute("y1"),yBot=+t0.getAttribute("y1");
  const maxT=parseFloat(ys[ys.length-3]?0:0);
  const tickVals=Array.from(svg.querySelectorAll(".axis text[text-anchor=end]")).map(t=>parseFloat(t.textContent)/100);const top=Math.max(...tickVals);
  const yy=yBot-(ra/top)*(yBot-yTop);S("line",{x1:t0.getAttribute("x1"),x2:t0.getAttribute("x2"),y1:yy,y2:yy,stroke:"var(--ink2)","stroke-dasharray":"5 4","stroke-width":1.5},svg);
  const ratio=rl>0?rh/rl:null;
  $("#try-take").textContent=`${FOLDNAME[fold]}: ${pct(rh)} of entries at or above the ${Math.round(p*100)}th-percentile share reached ${k}+ newcomer papers, against ${pct(rl)} below it`+(ratio?` (${ratio.toFixed(2)}×)`:"")+`; all entries: ${pct(ra)}. Mean newcomer papers ${mh.toFixed(2)} versus ${ml.toFixed(2)}.`;}
["try-fold","try-cut","try-k"].forEach(id=>$("#"+id).addEventListener("input",renderTry));onResize(renderTry,$("#try-chart"));

// 5. FAILURES
const fl={type:"hi0"};
function renderFail(){const fold=$("#fail-fold").value;const rows=ROWS[fold];const hiCut=quantile(ASORT[fold],0.8),med=quantile(ASORT[fold],0.5);
  let set,desc;
  if(fl.type==="hi0"){const top=rows.filter(r=>r.A>=hiCut);set=top.filter(r=>r.Y===0).sort((a,b)=>b.A-a.A);desc=`${fint(set.length)} of ${fint(top.length)} top-fifth-share entries (share ≥ ${hiCut.toFixed(3)}) drew no newcomer paper at all (${pct(set.length/top.length)}).`;
    $("#fail-take").textContent=`Even in the top fifth of host share, ${pct(set.length/top.length)} of ${FOLDNAME[fold]} entries attract no newcomers; compare ${pct(rows.filter(r=>r.A<hiCut&&r.Y===0).length/rows.filter(r=>r.A<hiCut).length)} below it. A high share shifts the odds; it does not guarantee uptake.`;}
  else{const bot=rows.filter(r=>r.A<med);set=bot.filter(r=>r.est).sort((a,b)=>a.A-b.A);desc=`${fint(set.length)} of ${fint(bot.length)} below-median-share entries (share < ${med.toFixed(3)}) took root anyway (${pct(set.length/bot.length)}).`;
    const top=rows.filter(r=>r.A>=med);$("#fail-take").textContent=`${pct(set.length/bot.length)} of below-median ${FOLDNAME[fold]} entries took root without host vocabulary, against ${pct(top.filter(r=>r.est).length/top.length)} above the median: host share is one input among several.`;}
  $("#fail-status").textContent=desc;const box=$("#fail-list");box.innerHTML="";
  set.slice(0,8).forEach(r=>{const b=document.createElement("button");b.type="button";b.innerHTML=`<strong>${esc(cname(r.c))}</strong> → ${esc(sname(r.d))}, ${r.e}: share ${r.A.toFixed(3)}, ${r.Y} newcomer paper${r.Y===1?"":"s"}`;
    b.addEventListener("click",()=>{$("#br-fold").value=fold;bState.fold=fold;bState.q=cname(r.c);$("#br-q").value=bState.q;bState.filter="all";$("#br-filter").value="all";bState.limit=200;bState.sel=r;renderBrowser();bState.sel=r;renderDetail();$("#h-browser").scrollIntoView({behavior:reduce?"auto":"smooth"});});box.appendChild(b);});
  if(set.length>8){const p=document.createElement("p");p.className="small";p.textContent=`First 8 of ${set.length} listed; open one to inspect it in the entry browser.`;box.appendChild(p);}}
$$("#fail-type button").forEach(b=>b.addEventListener("click",()=>{fl.type=b.dataset.f;$$("#fail-type button").forEach(x=>x.setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(x===b)));renderFail();}));
$("#fail-fold").addEventListener("change",renderFail);

// closure chart
function renderClosure(){const fold=$('input[name=cl]:checked').value;const host=$("#cl-chart");const W=widthOf(host);const rows=CLO.rows;const narrow=W<470;
  const probe=newSvg(host,W,10,"");const labW=narrow?0:Math.max(...rows.map(r=>textW(probe,r.label.replace(" closure",""),12)))+12;
  const rowH=narrow?44:36;const T=8,B=44;const H=T+rows.length*rowH+B;const L=labW+6,R=W-(narrow?10:84);
  const svg=newSvg(host,W,H,"Closure estimates");const lo=-2.0,hi=0.5;const x=v=>L+(v-lo)/(hi-lo)*(R-L);const ax=S("g",{class:"axis"},svg);
  [-2,-1.5,-1,-0.5,0,0.5].forEach(t=>{S("line",{x1:x(t),x2:x(t),y1:T,y2:H-B,class:"gridl"},ax);const tx=S("text",{x:x(t),y:H-B+15,"text-anchor":"middle"},ax);tx.textContent=t<0?MINUS+Math.abs(t):t;});
  S("line",{x1:x(0),x2:x(0),y1:T,y2:H-B,stroke:"#555","stroke-dasharray":"4 3"},svg);
  const xl=S("text",{x:(L+R)/2,y:H-8,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":12},ax);xl.textContent=`standardised difference S, ${fold==="heldout"?"Held-out":"Screen"} fold`;
  rows.forEach((r,i)=>{const d=r[fold];const y0=T+i*rowH;const cy=narrow?y0+28:y0+rowH/2;const g=S("g",{},svg);S("rect",{class:"hit",x:0,y:y0,width:W,height:rowH},g);
    const col=r.row==="constraint"?"var(--orange)":(fold==="heldout"&&r.decision==="CONFIRMED")?"var(--accent)":(fold==="screen"&&d.hi<0)?"var(--accent)":"var(--base)";

Its partner terms are either host-native (dark green) or from the origin vocabulary (light blue). The host-vocabulary share (orange) is the exposure in a pre-registered PPML regression with concept-clustered standard errors predicting 5-year newcomer uptake. The timelines and bars in (c) and (d) are schematic and carry no data values.</figcaption>\n  </figure>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ============================================================ EVIDENCE -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"evidence\" aria-labelledby=\"h-evidence\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-evidence\">Explore the evidence</h2>\n  <p class=\"prose\">The views below read the per-entry records the run saved: 1,740 Screen entries, 1,097 Held-out entries and 2,249 MeSH entries with at least five partners. The regressions keep 1,544, 972 and 2,171 of them once the fixed effects drop cells with no variation, so counts here are a little larger than the model samples.</p>\n\n  <h3 id=\"h-concept\">Within one concept, which entries took root?</h3>\n  <div class=\"card\">\n    <p class=\"q\"><strong>Does the gradient show up inside a single concept?</strong> Each bar is one host entry of the chosen concept, sorted by host-vocabulary share. Green bars are <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"rooted\">rooted</button> entries.</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <label for=\"concept-sel\">Concept</label>\n      <select id=\"concept-sel\"></select>\n      <span class=\"seg\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Paper cases\" id=\"case-btns\"></span>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"concept-chart\"></div>\n    <div class=\"legend\"><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--green)\"></i>rooted entry</span><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--base)\"></i>not rooted</span><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:none;border-top:2px dashed var(--ink2);height:0;width:18px\"></i>mean share of non-rooted entries</span></div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"concept-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <h3 id=\"h-browser\">Every entry: input, prediction and outcome side by side</h3>\n  <div class=\"card\">\n    <p class=\"q\"><strong>What does the host share add for one entry?</strong> Pick any recorded entry. The panel sets its inputs beside two out-of-sample predictions of newcomer papers: a controls-only model (the baseline) and the same model with host share and co-transfer added (the method), then the count that happened.</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <label for=\"br-fold\">Population</label>\n      <select id=\"br-fold\"><option value=\"screen\">Screen (1,740)</option><option value=\"heldout\">Held-out (1,097)</option><option value=\"mesh\">MeSH (2,249)</option></select>\n      <label for=\"br-q\">Search</label>\n      <input type=\"search\" id=\"br-q\" placeholder=\"concept or host subfield\" autocomplete=\"off\">\n      <label for=\"br-filter\">Show</label>\n      <select id=\"br-filter\"><option value=\"all\">all entries</option><option value=\"rooted\">rooted entries</option><option value=\"zero\">entries with no newcomers</option><option value=\"hi0\">high share, no newcomers</option></select>\n      <label for=\"br-sort\">Sort by</label>\n      <select id=\"br-sort\"><option value=\"A\">host share, high first</option><option value=\"Y\">newcomer papers, most first</option><option value=\"gain\">method closer than baseline</option><option value=\"loss\">method further than baseline</option></select>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"status\" id=\"br-status\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    <div class=\"browser\">\n      <div>\n        <div class=\"tablewrap\"><table id=\"br-table\"><caption class=\"sr\">Host-entry events</caption><thead><tr><th scope=\"col\">Concept</th><th scope=\"col\">Host subfield, year</th><th scope=\"col\" class=\"num\">Host share</th><th scope=\"col\" class=\"num\">Newcomer papers</th></tr></thead><tbody></tbody></table></div>\n        <div style=\"margin-top:8px\"><button type=\"button\" class=\"plain\" id=\"br-more\">Show 40 more</button></div>\n      </div>\n      <div class=\"detail card\" id=\"br-detail\" aria-live=\"polite\"></div>\n    </div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"br-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n\n  <h3 id=\"h-margins\">Does host share start uptake, or grow it?</h3>\n  <div class=\"card\">\n    <p class=\"q\"><strong>Which margin carries the effect?</strong> Each bar is a linear-probability estimate: percentage points added, per SD of host share, to the chance that an entry reaches the stated number of newcomer papers (<button class=\"term\" data-term=\"extensive\">extensive margin</button>). Thresholds rise from left to right.</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label=\"Population for the margin ladder\" id=\"mg-fold\">\n        <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"mg\" value=\"SCREEN\" checked>Screen</label>\n        <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"mg\" value=\"HELDOUT\">Held-out</label>\n        <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"mg\" value=\"MESH\">MeSH</label>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"mg-chart\"></div>\n    <div class=\"legend\"><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></i>CI excludes 0</span><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--base)\"></i>CI includes 0</span><span>whiskers: 95% CI</span></div>\n    <p class=\"small\" id=\"mg-note\"></p>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"mg-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ============================================================ TRY IT -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"tryit\" aria-labelledby=\"h-try\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-try\">Try it: move the cut-offs yourself</h2>\n  <div class=\"card\">\n    <p class=\"q prose\"><strong>What if we simply split entries at a host-share cut-off?</strong> Drag the sliders. The page recomputes, from the recorded entries, the share that reached at least <em>k</em> newcomer papers above and below the cut-off. These are raw shares with no fixed effects, so they mix concept, year and host differences that the paper's models remove; use them to see the pattern, not to replace the estimate.</p>\n    <div class=\"controls\">\n      <label for=\"try-fold\">Population</label>\n      <select id=\"try-fold\"><option value=\"screen\">Screen</option><option value=\"heldout\">Held-out</option><option value=\"mesh\">MeSH</option></select>\n      <label for=\"try-cut\">Host-share cut-off (percentile)</label>\n      <input type=\"range\" id=\"try-cut\" min=\"10\" max=\"95\" step=\"5\" value=\"80\" aria-describedby=\"try-cut-val\">\n      <output id=\"try-cut-val\" for=\"try-cut\" class=\"count\"></output>\n      <label for=\"try-k\">At least <em>k</em> newcomer papers</label>\n      <input type=\"range\" id=\"try-k\" min=\"1\" max=\"10\" step=\"1\" value=\"1\" aria-describedby=\"try-k-val\">\n      <output id=\"try-k-val\" for=\"try-k\" class=\"count\"></output>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"chart\" id=\"try-chart\"></div>\n    <div class=\"legend\"><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--base)\"></i>below cut-off</span><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></i>at or above cut-off</span><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:none;border-top:2px dashed var(--ink2);height:0;width:18px\"></i>all entries</span></div>\n    <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"try-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n  </div>\n</div>\n</section>\n\n<!-- ============================================================ FAILS -->\n<section class=\"block\" id=\"fails\" aria-labelledby=\"h-fails\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-fails\">Where it fails</h2>\n  <div class=\"two\">\n    <div class=\"card\">\n      <p class=\"q\"><strong>Which entries break the pattern?</strong> The effect is a gradient in expected counts, not a rule. Pick a failure type and a population.</p>\n      <div class=\"controls\">\n        <div class=\"seg\" role=\"group\" aria-label=\"Failure type\" id=\"fail-type\">\n          <button type=\"button\" aria-pressed=\"true\" data-f=\"hi0\">High share, no newcomers</button>\n          <button type=\"button\" aria-pressed=\"false\" data-f=\"lo1\">Low share, rooted</button>\n        </div>\n        <label for=\"fail-fold\">Population</label>\n        <select id=\"fail-fold\"><option value=\"screen\">Screen</option><option value=\"heldout\">Held-out</option><option value=\"mesh\">MeSH</option></select>\n      </div>\n      <p class=\"status\" id=\"fail-status\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n      <div class=\"faillist\" id=\"fail-list\"></div>\n      <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"fail-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"card\">\n      <p class=\"q\"><strong>Did network openness before take-off hold up?</strong> The paper's second question (RQ1): <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"smd\">standardised differences</button> in closure between concepts that later show <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"sustained\">sustained uptake</button> and matched controls. Only one measure survives <button class=\"term\" data-term=\"holm\">Holm correction</button> on the Held-out fold.</p>\n      <div class=\"controls\">\n        <div class=\"seg\" role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label=\"Fold for closure estimates\" id=\"cl-fold\">\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"cl\" value=\"heldout\" checked>Held-out</label>\n          <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"cl\" value=\"screen\">Screen</label>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      <div class=\"chart\" id=\"cl-chart\"></div>\n      <div class=\"legend\"><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--accent)\"></i>confirmed after Holm</span><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--base)\"></i>not confirmed</span><span><i class=\"sw\" style=\"background:var(--orange)\"></i>positive sign (not brokerage)</span></div>\n      <p class=\"takeaway\" id=\"cl-take\" aria-live=\"polite\"></p>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n  <h3>What the paper does not show</h3>\n  <ul class=\"plainlist prose\">\n    <li><strong>The main-arm folds are not true held-out tests.</strong> Event counts, population sizes and gating decisions were computed on both Screen and Held-out folds before outcomes were read. The independent evidence is the MeSH replication.</li>\n    <li><strong>The stricter specification is underpowered.</strong> With concept-by-year and host-by-year fixed effects the Held-out fold keeps 250 of 972 events in 30 clusters and gives IRR 0.98 (95% CI 0.70 to 1.37). Switch the headline chart to “Primary FE” to see it.</li>\n    <li><strong>The population is narrow.</strong> The pool is dominated by physics and computer-science concepts from arXiv, and MeSH covers only biomedicine-to-biomedicine entries. Social sciences, humanities and engineering are untested.</li>\n    <li><strong>Binary rooting is null on the Held-out fold</strong> (<em>p</em> = 0.16). The effect is graded, not a threshold; the margin ladder above shows it fade at higher thresholds there.</li>\n    <li><strong>Most entries are single papers.</strong> 87% of co-primary Screen events involve one entry-year paper. The pooled multi-team effect is positive (IRR 1.28, 95% CI 1.11 to 1.48), but the Held-out fold alone is underpowered for it.</li>\n    <li><strong>Cluster-robust p-values run hot.</strong> The estimator rejects 10% to 11% of null shuffles (target 5%). Wild-cluster bootstrap and permutation tests agree with the headline (Held-out wild <em>p</em> = 0.012, permutation <em>p</em> = 0.026).</li>\n    <li><strong>Host-specificity rests on a near-duplicate measure.</strong> The Balassa-index lift correlates 0.997 with the log of the continuous share within fixed effects, so it confirms the share rather than adding independent evidence.</li>\n    <li><strong>The adopter-level result is Screen-only.</strong> Adopters are enriched for prior exposure to the entry partners (OR 3.09, 95% CI 2.32 to 4.28), most of all to origin-vocabulary partners (FOREIGN OR 2.88, ADJACENT 1.91, NATIVE 1.47). The design cannot separate absorptive capacity from topical proximity.</li>\n  </ul>\n</div>\n</section>\n</main>\n\n<footer id=\"sources\" aria-labelledby=\"h-sources\">\n<div class=\"wrap\">\n  <h2 id=\"h-sources\" style=\"margin-top:0\">Links</h2>\n  <div class=\"links\">\n    <a class=\"btn primary\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new@fork/run_YczZzZ0_9kfq/paper.pdf\">Read the paper (PDF)</a>\n    <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new@fork/run_YczZzZ0_9kfq/report.pdf\">Read the full research report</a>\n    <a class=\"btn\" href=\"https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8892b7-occupancy-is-not-integration-for-new/tree/fork/run_YczZzZ0_9kfq\">Code repository</a>\n  </div>\n  <h2>Data provenance</h2>\n  <p class=\"prose small\">Each view reads a JSON block embedded in this page. I've built `interactive.html` (554 KB, one file, works offline) and linked it from `index.html`. I operated it in headless Chromium at widths from 360 to 1440 px: no console errors, no sideways scrolling and no overlapping chart labels.

**What's on the page**
- **The finding:** the question and answer, with the main result: +23% on the medical-terms (MeSH) population (IRR 1.23, 95% CI 1.12 to 1.36). Beside it is a live chart of the estimates. Readers can switch between the three test populations, origin fields and placebo hosts, and between the two model specifications. A checkbox shows co-transfer, the competing explanation.
- **How it works:** a six-stage walk-through of one real entry, EPR steering entering Artificial Intelligence in 2011, using the values the run recorded at each stage. The last stage works out IRR per SD = 1.30 from the recorded coefficient. Paper Figure 1 sits below it; it is the only paper figure on the page.
- **Explore the evidence:**
  - A per-concept chart of each concept's entries, sorted by host-vocabulary share, including the paper's four cases.
  - A browser over all 5,086 recorded entries. Each entry shows its inputs next to the baseline prediction, the method's prediction and the observed newcomer count.
  - A chart showing whether host share starts uptake or grows it, across thresholds.
- **Try it:** sliders for a host-share cut-off and a newcomer-paper threshold. They recompute raw uptake rates from the recorded entries, and the page says these are descriptive, with no fixed effects.
- **Where it fails:** a toggle that lists the entries breaking the pattern (high share but no uptake, low share but rooted). There is also the closure chart, where only persistent-neighbour closure is confirmed, and the paper's limitations.
- **Footer:** the links, which run file each view comes from, and a glossary of every term with a tooltip.

The build script checks every headline number against `paper.tex`.

**Three things you should know**
- **Two rounding differences with the paper.** In the held-out closure results, the run's files give −0.855 and 0.105 where the paper prints −0.86 and 0.11. The page shows the paper's values and puts the file values in the tooltips. The paper text may be worth correcting.
- **The paper's definition of "rooted" doesn't match the code.** The paper says "at least five newcomer papers in at least three of five years". The run's code uses at least three newcomer papers in total, with papers present in at least three of the five years. I found this because the page marked an entry with yearly counts 1, 3, 0, 3, 3 as rooted. The glossary gives both wordings. The paper sentence is worth fixing.
- **The per-entry views use slightly larger counts than the paper's models.** They use every recorded entry (1,740 / 1,097 / 2,249). The models keep 1,544 / 972 / 2,171 after dropping entries the fixed effects can't use, and the recorded files don't mark which ones. The page says this.

In `index.html` the only change is the "Explore the interactive demo" link, added next to the paper link in the hero and in the footer. The extraction script and screenshots are in my scratchpad, outside the published folder.

Files are in `paper/`:
- interactive.html
- index.html
